sourceSentences: Tryndamere reduces the bonus attack damage of nearby enemy champions for 4 seconds.
Tryndamere also applies a curse to all nearby enemy champions for 3.25 seconds. While accursed, they become slow [slowed] while facing away from Tryndamere.
A nearby enemy champion is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be sight [visible] to be targeted by this ability.
Mocking Shout very briefly sight [reveals] Tryndamere if he uses it while in the Fog of War to enemies.
Mocking Shout prevents Tryndamere from using Undying Rage during its cast time.
Tryndamere dashes to the target location, dealing physical damage to enemies hit and generating fury [2 Fury] per enemy hit, increased to 5 Fury against champions.
Critical strikes on-hit reduce Spinning Slash's current cooldown by 0.75 seconds, doubled to 1.5 seconds against champions.
Bloodlust [Tryndamere] and Undying Rage [Tryndamere] can be cast during the dash.
Flash will interrupt the dash but Spinning Slash will deal damage to enemies at the new location instantly.
Enemies already hit by Spinning Slash cannot be damaged more than once.
To ensure Spinning Slash deals damage when dashing away from an enemy champion, Tryndamere needs to move r-35 units towards the enemy beyond the distance he can basic attack at
The cooldown reduction upon critical strike [critically striking] triggers on wards and jungle plants and even if the attack is blocked, but not if it misses due to blind.
Tryndamere consumes all of his fury [Fury] to heal himself, increased for every point of Fury consumed.
Bloodlust can be activated at any point of Tryndamere's basic attack.
This means that if Bloodlust [Tryndamere] is cast during Tryndamere's attack windup, the attack will use the critical strike chance given by the Fury before the Bloodlust [Tryndamere] cast.
Furthermore, the Fury for that basic attack will be given once the windup completes. This lets Tryndamere start building Fury immediately.
Tryndamere becomes enraged, instantly gaining fury [Fury] and a minimum health threshold for 5 seconds.
Undying Rage can be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.
